text.en:
There shall be established in the Municipality of Matuguinao, Province of Samar, a national high
school to be known as the Matuguinao National High School.

Such amount as may be determined by the Minister of Education and Culture and the Minister of
the Budget as being necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged to the appropriations of the
Ministry of Education and Culture authorized under Batas Pambansa Blg. 40 for new national schools.
Beginning in 1981, such sum as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the above authorized
national school shall included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: January 21, 1981
